letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, my endless sunshine—each sunrise in Dubai and every monsoon breeze in Ahmedabad reminds me how lucky I am to share this beautiful chaos with you. I love the way you laugh at my corny jokes, the way your eyes sparkle when you plan our next adventure, and the way our love feels like a soft, warm blanket no matter where we are. Thank you for being my cutie, my confidante, and the heartbeat that makes every day feel like a celebration of us.
poem:
In desert dunes or city rain,  
Your smile erases every pain.  
From sand to spice, my love will stay,  
Forever yours, in every way.
